result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the “Fastest near you” carousel shows what appears to be the same restaurant/card duplicated twice in a row, which looks like a rendering or data duplication defect rather than intentional variety.

issues.description: Two adjacent cards in the “Fastest near you” section appear to duplicate the same restaurant: identical name “Green Bowl Poké,” same 15–25 min time, and same €0.90 delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Check the data source and rendering logic for the carousel to ensure unique restaurant entries are shown, or de-duplicate identical listings before display.
